messages:
kai: heads-up - after yesterday's telemetry handshake change, a couple customers reported broken ts-sdk auth handshakes. saw 401s and then immediate retries. anyone else?

mira: saw one trace: client sends Accept-Telemetry=1, server responds with 101 Telemetry-Ready header, then client tries to POST /telemetry but endpoint returns 401 because token was rotated mid-handshake. ts-sdk's retry logic treats 401 as terminal and surfaces error.

jon: ts-sdk v4.3.0 introduced stricter handshake flow expecting a Telemetry-Ack before sending bulk samples. older proxies and some gateway setups don't forward the Telemetry-Ready header correctly.

kai: product: this is causing a small burst of errors for a handful of tenants. suggestion: 1) revert strict behavior in next patch to be permissive, 2) console to add a flag to gate telemetry handshake behind Accept-Telemetry, 3) ops add alert for handshake-failures.

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/478 "ts-sdk: permissive telemetry handshake fallback"

jon: opening PR to fallback: if Telemetry-Ready not observed within 2s, continue without Telemetry-Ack and mark telemetry as best-effort. will log a single warn per minute per org. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/1055

ops-bot: Created alert rule "telemetry-handshake-failures" -> fires if handshake errors > 0.1% over 5m.

mira: console team will add a canary gate to only send Telemetry-Ready when client advertises support. ticket CONSOLE-821.

kai: ok let's ship the permissive patch and re-roll handshake canary at 5% after SDK release. thanks all for fast triage. :+1:
